# uem_mac_script (Resource)

Manages a macOS script in Workspace ONE UEM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_group_uuid" {
  type        = string
  description = "Organization group UUID that owns the script"
}

resource "uem_mac_script" "example" {
  organization_group_uuid = var.organization_group_uuid
  name                    = "Example Script"
  description             = "Sample bash script managed by Terraform"
  platform                = "APPLE_OSX"
  script_type             = "BASH"
  execution_context       = "SYSTEM"
  platform_architecture   = "UNKNOWN"

  # script_data must be base64-encoded. Use filebase64() to load a script from disk.
  script_data = base64encode(<<-EOT
    #!/bin/bash
    echo "hello from terraform"
  EOT
  )

  timeout = 30

  script_variables = [
    {
      name  = "GREETING"
      value = "hello"
    },
  ]

  allowed_in_catalog = true
  user_interaction   = false

  catalog_display = {
    display_name     = "Example Script"
    display_desc     = "Runs a simple greeting script"
    pre_action_text  = "This script will run on your Mac. Continue?"
    post_action_text = "The script has finished running."
    action_type      = "INSTALL"
    catalog_icon_url = "https://example.com/icons/script.png"
    categories       = ["1"]
  }
}

output "mac_script_id" {
  description = "Script UUID assigned by UEM"
  value       = uem_mac_script.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_in_catalog` (Boolean) Whether the script may appear in the Workspace ONE catalog
- `name` (String) Display name of the script
- `organization_group_uuid` (String) Organization group UUID that owns the script
- `platform` (String) Target platform for the script (e.g. APPLE_OSX)
- `script_data` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded script body to execute on the device
- `script_type` (String) Script language (e.g. BASH, ZSH, PYTHON)

### Optional

- `catalog_display` (Attributes) Catalog presentation settings when allowed_in_catalog is true (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--catalog_display))
- `description` (String) Description of the script. Read back exactly as UEM returns it: an unset description reads as `""` (empty string), not null, since UEM's wire format has no way to represent unset separately from empty.
- `execution_context` (String) Execution context for the script (e.g. USER, SYSTEM). The schema marks this Optional, but it is required at plan time: `ValidateConfig` (internal/scripts/mac/resource_validate.go) errors when it is left unset, because UEM answers a create without it with HTTP 500 (errorCode 1000) and creates nothing. Set it to USER or SYSTEM.
- `platform_architecture` (String) Platform architecture for the script (e.g. X64, ARM64)
- `script_variables` (Attributes List) Environment variables available to the script at runtime (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--script_variables))
- `timeout` (Number) Script execution timeout in seconds. UEM returns this even for a script created without it set explicitly (UEM's own default is 30); the provider reads it back exactly as UEM returns it. A configuration that omits this attribute plans no change once a value is recorded in state; set it explicitly to change it.
- `user_interaction` (Boolean) Whether the script requires user interaction before execution. UEM returns this even for a script created without it set explicitly (UEM's own default is false); the provider reads it back exactly as UEM returns it. A configuration that omits this attribute plans no change once a value is recorded in state; set it explicitly to change it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Script UUID assigned by UEM after creation

<a id="nestedatt--catalog_display"></a>
### Nested Schema for `catalog_display`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) Catalog action type for the script
- `catalog_icon_url` (String) URL of the icon displayed in the catalog
- `display_desc` (String) Description shown to end users in the catalog
- `display_name` (String) Name shown to end users in the catalog
- `post_action_text` (String) Text shown to the user after the script runs
- `pre_action_text` (String) Text shown to the user before the script runs

Optional:

- `categories` (List of String) Catalog category identifiers. Optional: when omitted, the resource takes UEM's value instead of planning null. UEM returns an empty list for a script that is in the catalog with no categories assigned; the provider reads that back as a known empty list, not null. A configuration that omits this attribute plans no change once a value is recorded in state; set it explicitly to change it.


<a id="nestedatt--script_variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `script_variables`

Required:

- `name` (String) Variable name
- `value` (String) Variable value

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Import an existing Workspace ONE macOS script into Terraform

# Import by script UUID
# Usage: terraform import uem_mac_script.example "<uuid>"

terraform import uem_mac_script.example "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
```
